item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We need to prevent that future—not treat it as an acceptable risk.

2. We believe plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and a catastrophe killing at least a billion people will follow. Our work is to help stop that from happening.

3. A catastrophe that kills at least a billion people will result if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years. We are working toward a ban on superintelligence because the stakes are human survival.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We face a choice with consequences for everyone alive. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is not a risk we can responsibly accept or manage after the fact. We work on communications and policy toward a ban on superintelligence because preventing its development is the only way to prevent this catastrophe. That means making the stakes clear, building public understanding, and urging decision-makers to act before the technology is built. The window to prevent this future is open now. We must use it.
